body:
I built Godot 4.4.dev and ran the console bin to get this readout
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/574bf5c3-fd5f-414e-8c5f-8876ab9a7c27)


As a side note, is there a way to get these logs to write out to a file?  I tried running it in self-contained mode using the _sc_ folder in the same directory as the bin to no avail.  I also checked the Godot folder in %AppData% and found nothing. I ended up having to use ScreenToGif to record the readout.  I am running it in a directory with write permissions.

I am considering becoming a contributor to try and solve this myself.  I have been reading the relevant documentation.  Would this bug fall into the "Good first issue" category?


Godot v4.4.dev (da4f9339e) - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 980 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6094) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-6700K CPU @ 4.00GHz (8 threads)

@nattyrice You didn't get a proper backtrace, be sure to build with `dev_build=yes`. See [the docs](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/4.3/contributing/development/compiling/introduction_to_the_buildsystem.html#introduction-to-the-buildsystem) for more info. In case you'd still have problems/questions (after reading relevant docs) you can ask for help in the Godot Contributors Chat, specifically in the [new-contributors channel](https://chat.godotengine.org/channel/new-contributors).

>I am considering becoming a contributor to try and solve this myself. I have been reading the relevant documentation. Would this bug fall into the "Good first issue" category?

I'd say it's a good issue for a first-time-contribution, I got it crashing here (which is a part of an isolated method):
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/da4f9339ea7f614f5965e6a6b918b8c8285f2e1d/editor/plugins/tiles/atlas_merging_dialog.cpp#L147
`dst_tile_data` seems to be null (hence it crashes) when AFAICT it's assumed it should never happen. You'd need to analyze the preceding code/logic, see what goes wrong there and fix it appropriately.
I've started working on fixing this bug.
